# EmulatorJS runtime

This directory contains the built browser runtime and SNES core files from
[EmulatorJS 4.2.3](https://github.com/EmulatorJS/EmulatorJS/releases/tag/v4.2.3).
They are hosted with this site so the Super Mario World launcher does not
depend on `cdn.emulatorjs.org`.

Included files are limited to the loader, interface, English localization,
archive extraction support, and the four SNES9x WebAssembly variants used by
EmulatorJS. The project is licensed under GPL-3.0; see `LICENSE`.

Game ROMs and artwork are not part of EmulatorJS and are not included here.
